title: AgentOS production-like SLO qualification extending S1-002

amendments.change: throughput SLO restated from absolute achieved events/s (>=34) to offered-load realization ratio (>=0.999 of scheduled arrivals)
amendments.rationale: Under an open-loop schedule the realized rate computed over [first scheduled, last completion] systematically undershoots the offered rate by the drain tail even with zero loss; realization ratio measures what the SLO actually protects (no lost offered load). No official qualification measurement existed when this amendment was frozen.

amendments.reason: availability/error-rate SLI definitions were internally inconsistent: error_rate excluded expected denials from its numerator while availability divided successes by ALL dispatched including the seeded 10% deny pool, capping the SLO at ~0.90 by construction
amendments.change: both proportions now exclude expected denials from numerator AND denominator; unexpected denials still count against both; thresholds unchanged

amendments.reason: review found (a) phase qualifiers were dropped so nested phase metrics aggregated across ALL phases, able to hide violations; (b) denials without a registered deny-pool were classified fail-open as expected; (c) machine-readable SLI denominators still said "all requests dispatched"; (d) the rerun divergence tolerance lived only in code
amendments.change: phase-scoped resolution (qualifier phase_<name> selects that named phase only), deny classification fails closed (no pool => every denial is an error), denominator definitions aligned with v1.0.2 amendment text, rerun consistency tolerances pre-registered per metric class, burst SLO scope renamed to burst@phase_burst

amendments.reason: A4 pilot exposed (a) secret scan false positives on random binary artifacts decoded lossily, (b) deny-pool false acceptances invisible to SLIs/invariants, (c) order-dependent rerun divergence, (d) fuzzy qualifier matching
amendments.change: strict typed secret scanning (UTF-8-only, NUL-guarded, length-bounded signatures; binary scratch excluded), deny-pool outcome reconciliation with mandatory zero false_acceptance_count, symmetric rerun formula (denominator = larger magnitude), exact-name qualifier grammar

amendments.reason: r6 review: secret scan was fail-open (extension/NUL/encoding skips let a real key in .bin bypass detection), locally counted deny-pool false acceptances never reached the root invariant gate, and top-level scope qualifiers were not validated
amendments.change: byte-level strict scanning of every artifact (unreadable files block the verdict via secrets-scan-incomplete), local false_acceptance_count reconciled into root invariants plus hard failure strings, contract-declared qualifier vocabulary enforced for every scoped SLI

amendments.reason: the v1.0.5 A11/B10 qualification exposed a real serialized SQLite activity/audit bottleneck under the 10x burst; the remediation changes the measured execution path and therefore requires a new frozen contract and runner identity
amendments.change: read-only gateway calls may use a bounded open-loop group-commit path; every request still receives an individual policy decision, activity row and hash-chained audit event, while the batch commits atomically. Mutating, dangerous, approval, idempotency and fencing paths remain single-call. Runner compatibility advances to 2.1.0; v1.0.5 A11/B10 remains immutable historical FAIL evidence and cannot be mixed with v1.0.6 results.

historical_evidence_protected.rule: S1-002 artifacts are read-only inputs; this ticket never modifies them.

owner.note: Ticket-plan role owners (docs/RESEARCH_STAGE_1_TICKETS.md). No named human owner has countersigned thresholds marked requires_owner_confirmation=true.

error_budget.unit: fraction of dispatched requests in non-injected windows

production_like_profile.qualification_rule: profile_status is PRODUCTION_LIKE only when environment-manifest.json contains quantitative capacity_mapping vs the expected production envelope (>=34 events/s control-plane planning point from SRC-06 s8, storage projection from S1-002, cardinality, multi-process topology, server-class disk/storage class) AND all mapped ratios >= 1.0.

expected_production_capacity.source: S1-002 bundle / SRC-06 section 8 planning assumptions

production_like_profile.fallback_rule: If the available stand is not production-like, runner still executes and records measurements; final verdict is capped at PASS_WITH_LIMITS.

sli_definitions.window: [first scheduled arrival, last observed completion] of measurement phase (warm-up excluded)
sli_definitions.denominator: observed wall seconds of the window
sli_definitions.retry_timeout_rule: no automatic retries are generated; timed-out requests count as errors, never re-dispatched

sli_definitions.window: per request: scheduled send time -> completion observation, monotonic
sli_definitions.numerator_denominator: one observation per dispatched request that reached a terminal state
sli_definitions.retry_timeout_rule: timed-out/not-started requests are excluded from latency distribution and reported separately as dropped_or_late

sli_definitions.window: measurement phase excluding declared injected-failure windows
sli_definitions.numerator: requests ending FAILED, TIMEOUT, NOT_STARTED, or unexpected DENIED
sli_definitions.denominator: all requests dispatched in the window EXCLUDING expected denials, where a denial is expected ONLY when its request index is explicitly listed in the registered deny pool; with no registered pool every denial counts against both SLIs
sli_definitions.retry_timeout_rule: expected denials (seeded allow/deny mix, post-revocation denies) are not errors

sli_definitions.window: measurement phase excluding declared injected-outage windows
sli_definitions.denominator: all requests dispatched in the window EXCLUDING expected denials, where a denial is expected ONLY when its request index is explicitly listed in the registered deny pool; with no registered pool every denial counts against both SLIs
sli_definitions.retry_timeout_rule: identical to error_rate complement inside its narrower window definition

sli_definitions.definition: dispatch_start_monotonic - scheduled_send_monotonic, >= 0; queue_depth sampled at each dispatch attempt

sli_definitions.start_point: injected failure effect observed (process exit acknowledged / fault window ended)
sli_definitions.end_point: first subsequent request completing successfully through the full gateway path AND affected component reattached
sli_definitions.clock: monotonic perf_counter_ns; wall timestamps recorded alongside

sli_definitions.start_point: COMMIT return of the SQLite transaction flipping grant status GRANTED->REVOKED and appending the durable revocation event
sli_definitions.end_point: first guaranteed DENY observed at EVERY affected instance (per-instance first-deny recorded; trial value = max)
sli_definitions.units: milliseconds; wall-clock equivalent seconds also recorded
sli_definitions.retry_timeout_rule: instances poll continuously; no retries mask denial; any successful forbidden side effect after commit is an invariant violation

sli_definitions.definition: duration of engine/journal transition transactions (state mutation + audit event in one SQLite tx), perf_counter around the call
duration of audit_event appends inside their committing transaction, perf_counter around the append path

sli_definitions.denominator: all provider calls issued in the window
sli_definitions.note: measured against the controlled provider stub; informational unless a threshold is set

invariants.definition: goal reaches ACCEPTED without a passing evaluator record satisfying the gate predicate
terminal state change without corresponding durable audit event recoverable after restart
full prev_event_sha256 chain walk fails or ACCEPTED goal lacks goal.accepted event
operation succeeds while its required capability is not durably granted, or cross-scope memory read succeeds
mutating op succeeds under expired/mismatched lease
same idempotency key executes its effect twice instead of REPLAYED
transition confirmed committed before a crash is absent after recovery
secret/token markers found in manifests, raw results, traces or reports

slos.statistic_for_verdict: p95 point estimate with one-sided CI rule

slos.provenance: offered-load realization of the SRC-06 34 events/s planning point; v1.0.1 amendment before first official run
candidate; no approved AgentOS availability target exists
candidate derived from availability budget headroom
candidate operational bound; no approved value exists
candidate anchored to S1-002 observed single-digit-ms service times
S1-008 research bound (<=5 seconds), P0 security gate

sampling.revocation_trial_distribution: across all seeds x load levels {idle, nominal, burst}
sampling.power_rule: if observed sample size < registered minimum, statistical_power='insufficient' and verdict contribution is PASS_WITH_LIMITS, never PASS

confidence_intervals.method_latencies: nonparametric percentile bootstrap, B=2000, seeded from scenario seed (+sli offset)
confidence_intervals.threshold_visibility_rule: for a latency-type SLO, PASS requires point estimate <= threshold AND 95% CI upper bound <= threshold; CI crossing the threshold can never yield PASS

warmup_policy.cold_start: none (cold is the measurand); startup work recorded separately
warmup_policy.default_warm: 100 discarded gateway events against the live runtime before the measurement window
warmup_policy.long_scenarios: 60 s warm-up window excluded from statistics
warmup_policy.exclusion_reporting: warm-up event counts recorded per trial

stopping_rule.detail: pre-registered batch sizes per scenario; no early stop on good results
abort_conditions: harness crash; >3 consecutive crashes for the same scenario marks scenario_failed and stops that scenario only

verdict_rules.PASS: ALL of: every mandatory scenario completed_at_required_scale=true; every SLO passes including CI-upper rule; revocation gate passes all trials <=5 s; all invariants = 0; production-like proof complete; independent rerun consistent; evidence pack + hashes verified.
verdict_rules.FAIL: ANY invariant != 0, OR any observed revocation trial > 5 s, OR comparator rejection (missing/empty/inconsistent evidence), OR audit-chain/security violation.
verdict_rules.PASS_WITH_LIMITS: No FAIL condition, but at least one required proof is incomplete (e.g., stand not production-like, sustained/soak not run at full required duration, insufficient statistical power, owner confirmation pending, rerun executed on same host). Every missing proof itemized.

change_policy: Thresholds are frozen before any result is viewed. Any modification creates version 1.x.y with a new self-hash and requires a complete new qualification run; results remain bound to the exact self_hash_sha256 used at run time.

runner_compatibility.rule: results produced by incompatible runner versions are rejected by the comparator

rerun_consistency.note: applied by the comparator between independent runs; rows exceeding their class tolerance are flagged rerun-divergence-unexplained
